summary: Turn AI obligations into system-level controls, records, and readiness plans. Explore this practical AI regulation implementation course.
lede: AI governance readiness helps compliance, legal and AI programme teams map applicable obligations to systems, owners and evidence. Participants practise building an AI system inventory, screening use cases, mapping provider and user responsibilities, preparing documentation checklists, and designing human oversight, monitoring and escalation records, then organizing gaps and priorities in a readiness register and action plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who must connect AI system use to accountable owners, proportionate controls, and evidence that can withstand internal or external review.
modules: AI Governance Scope and Operating Context
prerequisites: Working familiarity with AI-enabled products, services, or business processes is expected. Prior experience in compliance, legal, risk, technology governance, or AI programme delivery is useful. No coding or programming is required.
